_comment: Hand-authored lore adjustment for the arable-potential heatmap (board #4921,
epic #3675). Regenerate-through input, the river_overrides.json / inland_lakes.json
/ canon_cities.json idiom: edited deliberately, never inferred from a bitmap.
tools/generate_arable_heatmap.py. Each zone is a smooth radial bump around an
anchor pixel (canvas frame, 8192x3616), reaching 1.0 (no effect) at 'radius' px.
'factor' is the multiplier at the anchor: >1 lifts (breadbasket), <1 suppresses
AUTHORING GUIDANCE: this layer is MAGICAL/CURSE and BLESSED adjustment only
(blessed vales, vampire/plague curses, the Nehekharan dead land). It is NOT for
re-suppressing terrain (the terrain factor handles mountains), NOT for latitude
deserts (the climate arid trough handles Araby/Nehekhara's latitude), and NOT
for interior/rain-shadow aridity (the wind/rain-shadow moisture factor now
handles the Dark Lands, the Warpstone Desert, Kislev's steppe and generic
Badlands scrub PHYSICALLY, board #4921 wind-patterns follow-up). Represent
CURRENT arable (decision pinned): Nehekhara is a dead desert NOW, so its
Vitae-floodplain-as-was is NOT lifted. First draft that #3677 revises; anchors
are cheap to move and re-run.

zones.name: Bretonnia
zones.note: The Old World's archetypal breadbasket — the blessed, cultivated dukedoms of the Bretonnian heartland (Couronne/Lyonesse/Bordeleaux).

zones.name: Reikland vales
zones.note: The fertile Reik river vales at the heart of the Empire — its richest farmland.

zones.name: Averland
zones.note: The rolling pastoral vales of Averland, the Empire's grain and cattle south-east.

zones.name: The Moot
zones.note: Mootland, the halfling homeland at the confluence of the Aver and Stir (SW of Averland, between Averland and Stirland) — canonically the Empire's single most iconic breadbasket; the halflings feed the Empire.

zones.name: Tilea
zones.note: The cultivated Tilean coastal city-state hinterlands (a Mediterranean-analogue coast).

zones.name: Estalia
zones.note: The Estalian coasts and vega — a Mediterranean-analogue farmed coast.

zones.name: Sylvania
zones.note: The iconic cursed vampire province — blighted, barren fields under the von Carsteins. A magical curse (strengthened so it reads through the temperate climate that would otherwise green the eastern Empire).

zones.name: Mousillon
zones.note: The plague-ridden cursed dukedom, a localized blight inside otherwise-fertile Bretonnia.

zones.name: Troll Country
zones.note: The frozen, monster-haunted northern wilderness above Kislev — a troll-infested wasteland (its barrenness is monster/curse, kept as lore; the temperate climate at ~60N would otherwise not fully barren it).

zones.name: Blighted Marshes
zones.note: The fetid marshland on the Tilea/Estalia border and seat of Skavenblight — flooded, unfarmable wetland (not a rain-shadow desert, so kept in lore).

zones.name: Marshes of Madness
zones.note: The vast cursed Badlands marsh complex — endorheic, poisonous dead ground fed by the Blight Water river (this one zone now covers the former separate Blightwater zone; generic Badlands scrub is left to the physical moisture/climate model).

zones.name: Khemrian Desert
zones.note: Nehekhara as it is NOW — the magically dead desert of the Tomb Kings (Nagash's curse); the once-fertile Vitae floodplain is not lifted (current-arable decision). Kept as a magical curse on top of the latitude arid trough.
